title: Content not operable by keyboard
user_impact: Keyboard users are excluded from functionality.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard; WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3 widget roles and aria-activedescendant; HTML-AAM (a without href is generic)
applicability: Rendered, non-inert elements with an interactive widget role (button, link, checkbox, radio, switch, menuitem*, tab, option, treeitem).
expectation:
needs_review once per element that exposes an interactive role but cannot
take keyboard focus (no tabindex, not natively focusable): operating it from
the keyboard depends on script that the markup does not show. Not reported:
native controls, natively disabled fields, native <option>, options or items
whose ancestor manages focus with aria-activedescendant, elements not
rendered. An <a> without href has no link role (HTML-AAM: generic) and is
the business of keyboard/click-handler-not-focusable, not of this rule. A
tabindex removed by script after load counts.
